verdict.rationale: Mesh is API-first: every core workflow can run headlessly with no web UI. Machine API credentials come with scoped permissions and optional expiry. Screening runs synchronously or asynchronously, a Batch Processing API handles high volume, and WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks return results. Cases and alerts can be remediated via the API, exports can be triggered programmatically, and a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema and Postman collection support scripted integration. Missing for 10: no official CLI or CI-specific guidance (e.g., pipeline examples or a sandbox/test-mode for CI runs), and no hands-on authenticated run or independent report confirming end-to-end headless automation.
